No general runtime module resolver is admitted. Existing diff uses the literal packaged import; additional dynamic-loader callers must be adapted individually before production use.

Approved X-04 excludes arbitrary local file bytes and encoding guessing. The only admitted import consumes UTF8; it is supplied by the actual settings resource metadata. dependencies.reference: DOM, CSS, PointerEvent and accessibility APIs
dependencies.rationale: Browser controls have no Electron, Node, native handles or direct privileged persistence.
The real window editor composition owns the style scope and lifecycle. Modern UI assembly remains mandatory before visual sign-off.

divergences.summary: Keep original selectors and declarations, adding only a zero-specificity Proctor scope and exact theme variable prefix mapping. Original important declarations remain in reviewed override-layer rules.

Move existing product-specific ButtonControl, ToggleControl and MenuControl into explicitly named files with their unchanged styles/callers. They are not used as substitutes for upstream Button/Toggle/Menu contracts.

Keep local and TF-IDF search, tree renderers and JSON edit affordances. The single Principal document replaces workspace/remote/profile/extension/AI destinations. Readonly capability events, pending draft flush/discard/error events and lifecycle cancellation integrate with explicit Save. The modal footer participates in layout measurement and disposal.

An optional settings predicate keeps source defaults/group/search mechanics intact while the Proctor owner excludes unadmitted global registrations from its visible catalog and defaults document. The production modal and standalone model use the same owner.

verification.obligation: Verify complete source contracts with existing callers and the actual browser dependencies.
